494: void dump_state(void)
495: {
496: 	uint32_t bits = 0;
497: 
498: 	for (IRQn_Type irq_type = 0; irq_type < InterruptMAX_IRQn; irq_type++) {
499: 		if (irq_type == 32) {
500: 			BK_LOGI("int", "bits=%x\r\n", bits);
501: 			bits = 0;
502: 		}
503: 
504: 		if (NVIC_GetTargetState(irq_type)) {
505: 			uint32_t bit = irq_type % 32;
506: 			bits |= BIT(bit);
507: 		}
508: 	}
509: 
510: 	BK_LOGI("int", "high bits=%x\r\n", bits);
511: }

21: OUTPUT_FORMAT("elf32-littlearm", "elf32-bigarm", "elf32-littlearm")
22: 
23: __MSP_STACK_SIZE = (4 << 10);
24: __MIN_HEAP_SIZE  = (64 << 10);
25: __MPU_PROTECT_SIZE = 0x0;
26: 
27: __SWAP_SIZE = (2048);
28: 
29: #if CONFIG_CPU0_SRAM_BASE
30: __CPU0_APP_RAM_BASE = CONFIG_CPU0_SRAM_BASE;
31: #elif CONFIG_SPE
32: __CPU0_APP_RAM_BASE = SOC_SRAM0_DATA_BASE;
33: #else
34: __CPU0_APP_RAM_BASE = SOC_SRAM1_DATA_BASE;
35: #endif
36: 
37: #if CONFIG_SPE
38: __CPU0_APP_RAM_SIZE = CONFIG_CPU0_SPE_RAM_SIZE;
39: #else
40: __CPU0_APP_RAM_SIZE = CONFIG_CPU0_NSPE_RAM_SIZE;
41: #endif
42: 
43: 
44: /*****************************************************************************
45: The follow four shared memory address area mapping to the same physical memory 
46:     0x08000000 ~ 0x080a0000  ---- instruction area, recommend put sram code  
47:     0x18000000 ~ 0x180a0000  ---- instruction area, recommend put sram code 
48:     0x28000000 ~ 0x280a0000  ---- data area, recommend put sram data 
49:     0x38000000 ~ 0x380a0000  ---- data area, recommend put sram data 
50: ******************************************************************************/
51: __CPU0_APP_IRAM_OFFSET = 0x20000000;
52: 
53: __CPU0_APP_IRAM_BASE = __CPU0_APP_RAM_BASE - __CPU0_APP_IRAM_OFFSET;  /*0x08000000 = 0x28000000 - __CPU0_APP_IRAM_OFFSET*/
54: __CPU0_APP_IRAM_SIZE = __CPU0_APP_RAM_SIZE;
55: 
56: __CPU0_APP_VIRTUAL_CODE_START = CONFIG_PRIMARY_CPU0_APP_VIRTUAL_CODE_START;
57: __CPU0_APP_VIRTUAL_CODE_SIZE = CONFIG_PRIMARY_CPU0_APP_VIRTUAL_CODE_SIZE;
58: 
59: #if CONFIG_BT_REUSE_MEDIA_MEMORY
60: __BT_SRAM_BASE = __CPU0_APP_RAM_BASE + __CPU0_APP_RAM_SIZE;
61: __BT_SRAM_SIZE = CONFIG_BT_REUSE_MEDIA_MEM_SIZE;
62: #endif
63: 
64: MEMORY
65: {
66:   FLASH (rx)            : ORIGIN = (SOC_FLASH_DATA_BASE + __CPU0_APP_VIRTUAL_CODE_START), LENGTH = __CPU0_APP_VIRTUAL_CODE_SIZE
67:   IRAM (rx)             : ORIGIN = __CPU0_APP_IRAM_BASE, LENGTH = __CPU0_APP_IRAM_SIZE
68:   RAM (rwx)             : ORIGIN = __CPU0_APP_RAM_BASE, LENGTH = __CPU0_APP_RAM_SIZE - __SWAP_SIZE
69:   SWAP (rwx)            : ORIGIN = __CPU0_APP_RAM_BASE + __CPU0_APP_RAM_SIZE - __SWAP_SIZE, LENGTH = __SWAP_SIZE
70: 
71: #if CONFIG_BT_REUSE_MEDIA_MEMORY
72:   SRAM_BT (rwx)         : ORIGIN = __BT_SRAM_BASE, LENGTH = __BT_SRAM_SIZE 
73: #endif
74: 
75: #if (CONFIG_SOC_SMP)
76:   ITCM0 (rwx)           : ORIGIN = SOC_ITCM_DATA_BASE + __MPU_PROTECT_SIZE, LENGTH = CONFIG_ITCM_SIZE - __MPU_PROTECT_SIZE
77:   DTCM0 (rwx)           : ORIGIN = SOC_DTCM_DATA_BASE + CPU_ID_SPACE_SIZE, LENGTH = CONFIG_DTCM_SIZE - CPU_ID_SPACE_SIZE
78: 
79:   ITCM1 (rwx)           : ORIGIN = SOC_ITCM_DATA_BASE + __MPU_PROTECT_SIZE, LENGTH = CONFIG_ITCM_SIZE - __MPU_PROTECT_SIZE

528: static uint32_t uart_id_read_fifo_frame(uart_id_t id, const kfifo_ptr_t rx_ptr)
529: {
530: 	uint8_t read_val = 0;
531: 	uint32_t rx_count = sizeof(read_val);
532: 	uint32_t unused = kfifo_unused(rx_ptr);
533: 	uint32_t kfifo_put_cnt = 0;
534: 	__attribute__((__unused__)) uart_statis_t *uart_statis = uart_statis_get_statis(id);
535: 
536: 	//TODO: optimize flow ctrl
537: 	while (uart_hal_is_fifo_read_ready(&s_uart[id].hal, id)) {
538: 		/* must read when fifo read ready, otherwise will loop forever */
539: 		read_val = uart_hal_read_byte(&s_uart[id].hal, id);
540: 		// UART_LOGD("read val:0x%x, rx_count/unused: %d/%d\n", read_val, rx_count, unused);
541: 		if (rx_count > unused) {
542: 			if (!uart_hal_is_flow_control_enabled(&s_uart[id].hal, id)) {
543: 				UART_LOGW("rx kfifo is full, out/in:%d/%d, unused:%d\n", rx_ptr->out, rx_ptr->in, unused);
544: 				UART_STATIS_INC(uart_statis->kfifo_status.full_cnt);
545: #if CFG_CLI_DEBUG
546: 				extern void cli_show_running_command(void);
547: 				cli_show_running_command();
548: #endif
549: 			}
550: 		} else {
551: 			kfifo_put_cnt += kfifo_put(rx_ptr, &read_val, sizeof(read_val));
552: 			UART_STATIS_INC(uart_statis->kfifo_status.put_cnt);
553: 			UART_STATIS_SET(uart_statis->kfifo_status.last_value, read_val);
554: 		}
555: 		unused = kfifo_unused(rx_ptr);
556: 	}
557: 	UART_STATIS_SET(uart_statis->kfifo_status.in, rx_ptr->in);
558: 	UART_STATIS_SET(uart_statis->kfifo_status.out, rx_ptr->out);
559: 
560: 	return kfifo_put_cnt;
561: }
